name: crew-design
description: Real design: one item per thing that appears on screen (machine, building, place, procedure, kit). A specialist in a new session designs it for real, the critic checks domain truth, the specialist revises, the director approves. Cast, sets and shots are drawn from these specs.

steps.name: design
steps.job: Role: the specialist named in the item data (field), working as a real professional on a real product. Load skill crew (section 'Everything on screen is real'). Inputs: the item's data (unit, field, brief) plus <dir>/scripts/<script> (the scene) and <dir>/bible/bible.md, and any approved specs already in <dir>/design/. Design the thing for real: how it works, numbers, materials, colours (hex), parts, behaviour in each scene event, and a 'Depiction' section (views the camera needs, signature details, what is never shown, prompt-ready wording). Write <dir>/design/<unit>.md. Do not edit shared files; if the script must change for truth, list the exact edits in a 'Script notes' section for the director. Record the step with vex.factory.step.complete: {"files": [absolute path], "kind": "text", "summary": "<2 lines>"}.

steps.name: revise
steps.job: Role: the same specialist. Read the critic verdict files listed in the critic step output (vex.factory.item.get shows it). Fix every defect you agree with in <dir>/design/<unit>.md; for each one you reject, give the reason from your field. Record {"files": [...], "kind": "text", "fixed": [...], "rejected": [{"defect": ..., "why": ...}]}.

steps.name: approve
steps.question: Director: is this design true, complete and approved as the source for cast, sets and shots?
